name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Free Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of visa-exempt countries may enter without prior authorisation; others must obtain a uniform Schengen visa in advance from a Greek consulate or the consulate of another Schengen state.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Schengen short-stay visa if not visa-exempt.

requirements.blocker_text: Stay is capped at 90 days within any rolling 180-day period across the entire Schengen area, not just Greece.

evidence_required.document: Proof of sufficient financial resources for the stay (subject to border-check discretion)

sources.title: Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- What is a Schengen Visa (90/180 rule, visa-exempt vs visa-required nationalities)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build. Standard Schengen-area 90/180 short-stay rule, confirmed at tier-1 (mfa.gr). Does not itself lead to any residence status -- purely a visit route. The source does not detail overstay penalties; not modelled here since this route only covers the entry/eligibility side.
